title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-15
content:
Security Eng Sync - 2026-03-15
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Liam Chen, Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz, Rita Morales, (notes: Aisha)

Agenda:
- Quick updates / outstanding action items
- Vulnerability triage: SEC-412, SEC-398 follow-ups
- Secrets scanning & rotation status
- Threat modeling for Private/on-prem deployment changes
- Incidents / backlog review 

Notes:
1) Vulnerability triage (SEC-412 - remote code exec in third-party tokenizer)
- Summary: 3rd-party tokenizer lib v2.4.1 flagged by OSS scanner; PoC shows potential RCE with crafted input in pipeline stage.
- Current risk: HIGH for Dedicated and Private (customer-managed models) due to exposed model preprocessors on inference path. Hosted API less likely due to sandboxing but still relevant.
- Action plan: Priya to open hotfix PR to pin tokenizer to patched 2.4.3 + add sanitization layer in runtime input parsing. Liam to prepare canary rollout on staging Dedicated pool.
- Timeline: hotfix PR by 2026-03-17, canary rollout 2026-03-18, full deploy 2026-03-20 (if no regressions).
- Blockers: one failing integration test in runtime tokenization (Samuel investigating).

2) Vulnerability follow-ups (SEC-398 - minor privilege escalation in admin console)
- Status: low/medium; remediation merged but needs infra migration for cookie flag changes. Rita to coordinate with infra for migration window (ETA 2026-03-22).

3) Secrets scanning & rotation
- Snyk/TruffleHog run found 4 potential leaked items in older service repos; 2 are false positives (old test keys), 2 are active: one AWS access key (service-account-deploy-prod), one GCP service key (monitoring-worker).
- Immediate steps: rotate both active keys now. Samuel to create rotation tickets and rotate via IAM; Priya to update CICD secrets store and verify deployments.
- Longer term: add pre-commit hook + CI block for base64-looking blobs and extend scanning window to include archived branches.
- Questions: do we want automated forced rotation every 90 days for infra service accounts? Consensus: yes for infra accounts, eval for app-level keys. Action: Aisha to draft rotation policy doc (linked).

4) Threat modeling - Private/on-prem deployment (notes from sketch session)
- New feature: allow customer-managed inference mesh with cross-region peering and optional local model caching.
- Key assets: model artifacts, KV cache, customer data in transit, operator credentials.
- Threats discussed: unauthorized model exfiltration, insider threat via operator consoles, MITM on peered links, cache poisoning, key compromise on initial bootstrap.
- Mitigations proposed: mTLS for peering, HSM-backed key wrap for model keys, strict RBAC on operator console + SCIM SSO enforcement, signed model artifacts + attestations, cache integrity checks.
- Follow ups: Priya to run a lightweight DFD and threat table by 2026-03-19; team to calendar a deep threat-modeling workshop 2026-03-24 (2 hours).

5) Incidents / backlog
- Incident recap: small auth regression caused increased 401s on Dedicated (seen 2026-03-14). Root cause: token cache eviction change in release-2026-03-10. Patch rolled out and metrics normalizing. Postmortem draft in PR.
- Backlog highlights: WAF tuning (SEC-421), improve observability for model-execution errors (SEC-433), secrets playbook update (SEC-440).

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Priya: hotfix PR for tokenizer pin + sanitization (due 2026-03-17) - linked SEC-412
- Liam: canary rollout & perf validation on Dedicated staging (start 2026-03-18)
- Samuel: rotate AWS/GCP keys + create rotation tickets (due 2026-03-16)
- Rita: coordinate admin-console cookie migration with infra (due 2026-03-22)
- Aisha: draft 90-day rotation policy + post meeting notes to Confluence (due 2026-03-18)
- Team: threat-modeling workshop prep (Priya lead) (workshop 2026-03-24)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Need to confirm rollback window for tokenizer change if canary shows perf regression.
- Evaluate whether to block model uploads that are not signed in Private deployments.
- Add a quick runbook for rotating keys used by on-prem bootstrap (low friction).

Next meeting: 2026-03-22 10:00am PT (weekly cadence).

Quick links referenced in meeting:
- SEC-412: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-412
- Secrets Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/Secrets-Scanning-Playbook
- Runtime PR for tokenization fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2892

End of notes.
